finalText:
Found it. `computeTotal` was rounding to cents in USD twice — once after the percent coupon, once after the flat coupon — before ever converting to the order's currency. That intermediate rounding threw away fractions of a cent that mattered once the exchange rate got applied, so the final rounded total landed a cent off.

It only showed up with `SAVE10PCT` in GBP, CAD, and JPY, because those rates don't cleanly preserve the pre-rounded cent value — USD and EUR happened to dodge it with these test baskets.

Fixed by dropping the two intermediate roundings so the math stays exact in USD until the single final round, in the target currency's own decimal places. All 40 tests pass now.
